notes: Hosts that scrapescope run --env-all carries DIRECT (never to the upstream proxy) and reports as non-target: LLM APIs a job calls on its own behalf, which the job never sent through its proxy before --env-all set proxy variables for the whole child. The meter connects to them from this machine's own IP address, for every client of the meter. Cloud-storage hosts (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, R2) are deliberately not listed: buckets are often scrape targets, and carrying them direct would expose the user's IP to the bucket owner. Only exact API hostnames and provider-owned wildcards belong here. One known trade-off: OpenRouter serves its API (openrouter.ai/api/v1) on the same host as its website, and host rules cannot tell paths apart, so under --env-all a job's requests to openrouter.ai web pages also leave direct from this machine's IP and are not metered. Without --env-all this catalog is only used to label hosts in --redact-hosts reports.
